chunks.arabic_text: وَرَوَى رِبْعِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَالْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Ribʿī ibn ʿAbdillāh and al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding His saying, Mighty and Majestic:

chunks.arabic_text: وَمَنْ قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ فَلْيُنْفِقْ مِمَّا آتَاهُ اللَّهُ

translations.en: And whoever has his provision restricted, let him spend from what Allah has given him.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «إِنْ أَنْفَقَ عَلَيْهَا مَا يُقِيمُ ظَهْرَهَا مَعَ كِسْوَةٍ وَإِلَّا فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا».

translations.en: He said: "If he spends on her what sustains her strength along with clothing, otherwise they shall be separated."

en.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic command to spend according to one's means in the context of a husband's obligation toward his wife. The Imam عليه السلام clarifies that he must provide her with sustaining maintenance and clothing; otherwise, separation may be imposed between them.
en.seo_question: What does the verse about restricted provision mean for a husband's financial duty toward his wife?

key_terms.رِزْقُهُ: his provision or livelihood apportioned to him
key_terms.فَلْيُنْفِقْ: so let him spend or provide financially
key_terms.يُقِيمُ ظَهْرَهَا: what sustains her bodily strength and basic support
key_terms.كِسْوَةٍ: clothing owed as part of maintenance
key_terms.فُرِّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا: they are separated due to failure of support
